title: Eurozone bond yields edge lower as oil prices stabilise, ECB rate bets ease - The Economic Times
text:
Eurozone government bond yields edged lower as oil prices stabilised and investors assessed easing geopolitical risks following US midterm elections. However, rising inflation, potential ECB rate hikes and political uncertainty in France continued to shape market sentiment and influence European debt markets.
